Description: (v15.0) Deploy a multi AZ A-A solution,repo: https://github.com/FortinetCloudCSE/fortigate-aws-gwlb-cloudformation

VPCCIDR.Description: Provide a network CIDR for the VPC
VPCCIDR.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block format.

NumOfAZs.Description: Select the number of Availability Zones to use (Min 2, Max 6)

PublicSubnetCIDRs.Description: Provide a list of network CIDRs for Public Subnets (Min 2, Max 6)

PrivateSubnetCIDRs.Description: Provide a list of network CIDRs for Private Subnets (Min 2, Max 6)

GwlbSubnetCIDRs.Description: Provide a list of network CIDRs for GLWB Subnets (Min 2, Max 6)

AttachmentSubnetCIDRs.Description: Provide a list of network CIDRs for TGW Attachment Subnets (Min 2, Max 6)

Attachment.Description: Select Yes if you plan to attach this VPC to Transit GW or Cloud WAN with a VPC attachment, otherwise select No

TgwCreation.Description: Select Yes if you want to deploy a new Transit GW and two Transit GW Route Tables

TgwExisting.Description: [Leave blank if an existing TGW will not be used] If you are using an existing Transit GW, provide the Transit GW ID to create VPC routes to reach it

TgwExistingSecurityTgwRtb.Description: [Leave blank if an existing TGW will not be used] If you are using an existing Transit GW, provide the Transit GW RouteTable ID for the security VPC to associate to

TgwExistingSpokeTgwRtb.Description: [Leave blank if an existing TGW will not be used] If you are using an existing Transit GW, provide the Transit GW RouteTable ID that your spoke VPCs are associated with

TgwExistingSpokeTgwRtbRoute.Description: [Ignore if an existing TGW will not be used] If you are using an existing Transit GW, provide a network CIDR to create a route in your Transit GW RouteTable that your spoke VPCs are associated with

CwanCreation.Description: Select Yes if you want to deploy a new Cloud WAN network with production, development, sharedservices, and firewall segments

CwanExisting.Description: [Leave blank if an existing Cwan will not be used] If you are using an existing Cloud WAN, provide the Cloud WAN Core Network ID to create VPC routes to reach it

CwanExistingSegmentKey.Description: [Leave blank if an existing Cwan will not be used] Provide the name that should be used to create a Tag on the Cwan VPC Attachment to allow CWAN attachment automation

CwanExistingSegmentValue.Description: [Leave blank if an existing Cwan will not be used] Provide the value that should be used to create a Tag on the Cwan VPC Attachment to allow CWAN attachment automation

NumOfFgtsPerAZ.Description: Select the number of Fgts to deploy in each AZ (ie Fgt1a-us-east-1a, Fgt1b-us-east-1a) (Min 1, Max 2)

InstanceType.Description: Select the instance type for the FortiGates

CIDRForInstanceAccess.Description: Provide a network CIDR from which the FortiGate instances will be accessed
CIDRForInstanceAccess.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block format.

KeyPair.Description: Select a keypair to associate with the FortiGates

EncryptVolumes.Description: Select 'true' to encrypt the FortiGate instance OS and Log volumes with your account's KMS default master key for EBS.  Otherwise select false to leave unencrypted

InitS3Bucket.Description: [BYOL Only, leave blank otherwise] Provide the Init S3 Bucket name, where your config files will be created  *** the bucket should exist in the same region as this deployment for successful bootstrapping ***

FortiOSVersion.Description: Select the version of FortiOS to use (latest GA AMI will be used)

LicenseType.Description: Select the license type for the FortiGates

LicenseFilesFor1stFgtPerAZ.Description: [BYOL Only, leave blank otherwise] Provide a list of file names of the BYOL license files in the Init S3 Bucket for the first Fgts to be deployed in each AZ (ie 'fgt1a.lic, prefix/fgt2a.lic' for Fgt1a-us-east-1a, Fgt2a-us-east-1b) (Min 2, Max 6)

LicenseFilesFor2ndFgtPerAZ.Description: [BYOL Only, leave blank otherwise] Provide a list of file names of the BYOL license files in the Init S3 Bucket for the second Fgts to be deployed in each AZ (ie 'fgt1b.lic, prefix/fgt2b.lic' for Fgt1b-us-east-1a, Fgt2b-us-east-1b) (Min 2, Max 6)

FortiFlexTokensFor1stFgtPerAZ.Description: [Flex Only, leave blank otherwise] Provide a list of FortiFlex Tokens for the first Fgts to be deployed in each AZ (ie '1A1A1A1A1A1A1A1A1A1A, 2A2A2A2A2A2A2A2A2A2A' for Fgt1a-us-east-1a, Fgt2a-us-east-1b) (Min 2, Max 6)

FortiFlexTokensFor2ndFgtPerAZ.Description: [Flex Only, leave blank otherwise] Provide a list of FortiFlex Tokens for the second Fgts to be deployed in each AZ (ie '1B1B1B1B1B1B1B1B1B1B, 2B2B2B2B2B2B2B2B2B2B' for Fgt1b-us-east-2a, Fgt2b-us-east-2b) (Min 2, Max 6)
